lines.zh: 我用宽扁的脑袋拨开淤泥。
lines.en: I push the silt aside with my wide flat skull.

lines.zh: 我摆动尾巴，贴着河底滑行。
lines.en: I swing my tail and glide along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 骨头一样的头，破水而行。
lines.en: A skull like a boomerang cuts through the water.

lines.zh: 我一步一陷，踩进软泥里。
lines.en: Every step of mine sinks into the soft mud.

lines.zh: 四条短腿划着，慢慢挪动。
lines.en: Four stubby legs paddle me forward.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇根之间穿过去。
lines.en: I slip between the reed roots.

lines.zh: 水面下只有我拖出的波纹。
lines.en: Only my ripple marks the water's surface.

lines.zh: 我朝浅滩那头的鱼群游去。
lines.en: I head for the shoal beyond the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的头太重，游起来有点歪。
lines.en: My head is heavy; I swim a little lopsided.

lines.zh: 泥浆翻起来，又慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: The mud I stir rises, then settles again.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流，往石缝里钻。
lines.en: I follow the current into a crevice of stone.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，我转过半个身子。
lines.en: One flick of my tail turns me halfway around.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草边缘走，不惊动它们。
lines.en: I keep to the weed's edge and disturb nothing.

lines.zh: 这具身体在岸上很笨拙。
lines.en: On land this body of mine is clumsy.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子爬过湿石头。
lines.en: I drag my belly over the wet stones.

lines.zh: 前方的水面反光，我眯起眼。
lines.en: The glare ahead makes me narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，像块会动的木头。
lines.en: I sway along like a piece of walking driftwood.

lines.zh: 我绕开深水，那里有大鱼。
lines.en: I skirt the deep water; big fish live there.

lines.zh: 我伏在河底，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie on the riverbed without moving.

lines.zh: 气泡从我嘴边慢慢冒上去。
lines.en: Bubbles drift up slowly from my jaw.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进泥，只露头顶
lines.en: I bury myself in mud with only the top of my head out.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我就顺势晃一晃。
lines.en: The current nudges me and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 我在等一条没长眼的鱼。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a fish with no sense.

lines.zh: 阳光透过水，落在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the water onto my back.

lines.zh: 我咬住一截水草，嚼了两下。
lines.en: I bite a piece of weed and chew twice.

lines.zh: 这里的泥很软，正合我意。
lines.en: The mud here is soft, just right for me.

lines.zh: 岸上有脚步，我没抬头。
lines.en: Footsteps on the bank; I don't look up.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻拍着水底。
lines.en: My tail taps lightly on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，让水流过牙齿。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let water pass my teeth.

lines.zh: 我的头骨宽得像一把桨。
lines.en: My skull is as broad as a paddle.

lines.zh: 有什么从上游漂下来了。
lines.en: Something is drifting down from upstream.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉下去，藏住身形。
lines.en: I sink slowly and hide my shape.

lines.zh: 我隔着水面看你弯腰
lines.en: I watch you bend down through the water.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但记得你的影子。
lines.en: I don't know you, but I remember your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的手在动，是鱼吗？
lines.en: Your hand moves. Is it a fish?

lines.zh: 我从水下抬头，与你对视。
lines.en: I raise my head from the water and meet your eyes.

lines.zh: 这块头骨，你看着眼熟吗？
lines.en: Does this skull look familiar to you?

lines.zh: 你一走近，水就浑了。
lines.en: You step closer and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，像一把斜放的斧。
lines.en: I tilt my head like a leaning axe.

lines.zh: 你要下水，还是只想看？
lines.en: Will you come in, or only watch?

lines.zh: 我盯着你脚边那圈涟漪。
lines.en: I stare at the ripple around your feet.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的牙不认人。
lines.en: Don't reach in; my teeth know no one.

lines.zh: 头骨撞在石头上，嗡嗡响
lines.en: My skull knocks the stone and rings.

lines.zh: 谁碰我？水都晃了。
lines.en: Who touched me? The water shook.

lines.zh: 我缩起四肢，沉进泥里。
lines.en: I pull in my limbs and sink into mud.

lines.zh: 这一下，比大鱼撞得重。
lines.en: That hit harder than a big fish's charge.

lines.zh: 我痛得尾巴都僵了。
lines.en: The pain stiffens my tail.

lines.zh: 别打头，头是我的桨。
lines.en: Not the head; my head is my paddle.

lines.zh: 我这脑袋翻不了身。
lines.en: This head of mine can't roll over.

lines.zh: 血混进水里，散开了。
lines.en: Blood mixes into the water and spreads.

lines.zh: 我往深处退，退得很慢。
lines.en: I back into deeper water, slowly.

lines.zh: 这个仇，我记着。
lines.en: I'll remember this.

lines.zh: 是鱼味，我闻到了。
lines.en: Fish. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 那条鱼在你手里挣扎。
lines.en: That fish is struggling in your hand.

lines.zh: 把鱼丢下来，我就不追你。
lines.en: Drop the fish and I won't chase you.

lines.zh: 我整条身子都转向你了。
lines.en: My whole body has turned toward you.

lines.zh: 银色的鳞片，我喜欢。
lines.en: Silver scales. I like those.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张着，等一条鱼。
lines.en: My mouth waits, open, for a fish.

lines.zh: 鱼尾一摆，我的头就转
lines.en: The fish flicks its tail, and my head turns.

lines.zh: 我踮起前肢，还是差一截
lines.en: I prop myself up, but I am still short.

lines.zh: 水被我的尾巴搅响了。
lines.en: My tail is churning the water loud.

lines.zh: 那是给我的，对吧？
lines.en: That's for me, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我撞上你的腿，滑开了。
lines.en: I bump your leg and slide off.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我没看清岸边。
lines.en: Sorry, I didn't see the bank.

lines.zh: 硬邦邦的，不是鱼。
lines.en: Hard. Not a fish.

lines.zh: 我的头撞得发闷。
lines.en: My head rings from the knock.

lines.zh: 你挡在我和深水之间。
lines.en: You're between me and the deep water.

lines.zh: 我用宽头拨开水，挤过去
lines.en: I part the water with my broad head and squeeze past.

lines.zh: 水花溅上你的裤脚
lines.en: Water splashes up your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，重新对准方向。
lines.en: I back off half a step and re-aim.

lines.zh: 别踩我，我的骨头很脆。
lines.en: Don't step on me; my bones are brittle.

lines.zh: 我的头骨顶在你小腿上
lines.en: My skull bumps against your shin.

lines.zh: 产卵的季节，水会变暖。
lines.en: In spawning season the water grows warm.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩上找一块软泥。
lines.en: I look for soft mud in the shallows.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴，搅出同一圈波纹。
lines.en: Two tails stir one ring of ripples.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I lower my head and come in slowly.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是在等同伴。
lines.en: Don't worry; I'm only waiting for my own kind.

lines.zh: 这一窝卵，会藏在泥下面。
lines.en: This clutch will be hidden under the mud.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，谁也没碰谁。
lines.en: We swim side by side and never touch.

lines.zh: 水草会替它们挡住天敌。
lines.en: The weeds will shield them from hunters.

lines.zh: 我的头骨，也曾经这么小。
lines.en: My skull was once this small too.

lines.zh: 到季节了，我就得做这些。
lines.en: The season comes, and I do what I must.

lines.zh: 我叼住它，慢慢咽下去。
lines.en: I catch it and swallow it slowly.

lines.zh: 这块肉够我撑一天。
lines.en: This meat will last me a day.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬紧，不让它溜。
lines.en: I clamp my teeth so it can't slip.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进泥里去藏。
lines.en: I drag it into the mud to hide.

lines.zh: 掉在水底的，都归我。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the bottom is mine.

lines.zh: 我一口接住，水花溅起。
lines.en: I snap it up and water splashes.

lines.zh: 这味道，比水草强。
lines.en: This tastes better than weed.

lines.zh: 我用前肢按住，再咬。
lines.en: I pin it with a forelimb, then bite.

lines.zh: 它还在动，我不急。
lines.en: It's still moving; I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 吃完我把嘴在沙上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: Done. I wipe my mouth on the sand.

lines.zh: 那边有条鱼，翻了身。
lines.en: A fish over there has turned on its side.

lines.zh: 我一动，水纹就暴露了我。
lines.en: I move, and the ripple gives me away.

lines.zh: 找到了，就在石头后面。
lines.en: Found it, right behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁住了那道银光。
lines.en: My eyes lock onto that flash of silver.

lines.zh: 它受伤了，游得很慢。
lines.en: It's hurt and swimming slowly.

lines.zh: 我算好了这一扑的距离
lines.en: I have measured the distance of this lunge.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，贴住河底。
lines.en: I flatten myself against the riverbed.

lines.zh: 那条鱼还不知道我在。
lines.en: That fish doesn't know I'm here.

lines.zh: 我选了最小的一条。
lines.en: I pick the smallest one.

lines.zh: 头骨先转，身体才跟上。
lines.en: My skull turns first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，一寸一寸地挪。
lines.en: I follow it, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 它绕圈，我也绕圈。
lines.en: It circles, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我不追快鱼，只等它累。
lines.en: I don't chase fast fish; I wait for them to tire.

lines.zh: 它躲进水草，我看见草在动。
lines.en: It hides in the weeds; I see the weeds move.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经贴到它尾巴边。
lines.en: My teeth are at its tail already.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，就一口。
lines.en: A little closer and it's one bite.

lines.zh: 它往上浮，我不跟。
lines.en: It rises; I don't follow.

lines.zh: 河底的声音，我听得很清。
lines.en: The riverbed's sounds reach me clearly.

lines.zh: 我盯着那道影子，不眨眼。
lines.en: I hold that shadow without blinking.

lines.zh: 它跑不了多远，水就这么深。
lines.en: It can't go far; the water is shallow.

lines.zh: 一口咬住，牙嵌进鳞里。
lines.en: One bite, teeth sunk through scales.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它撕下一块。
lines.en: I wrench my head and tear a piece off.

lines.zh: 这一撞，它翻了白肚。
lines.en: The ram turns it belly-up.

lines.zh: 我的头骨像锤子砸下去。
lines.en: My skull comes down like a hammer.

lines.zh: 咬空了，泥水糊了我一脸。
lines.en: I bite empty water; mud fills my face.

lines.zh: 它挣，我不松口。
lines.en: It thrashes; I don't let go.

lines.zh: 这一口，够它受的。
lines.en: One bite like that is more than enough.

lines.zh: 水变红了，我看不清。
lines.en: The water reddens and I can't see.

lines.zh: 我把它按进泥里。
lines.en: I press it down into the mud.

lines.zh: 咬完我退回深水。
lines.en: After the bite I retreat to deeper water.

lines.zh: 泥里裂开一道缝，我钻出来。
lines.en: A crack opens in the mud and I come out.

lines.zh: 二叠纪的水，比这里冷。
lines.en: The Permian water was colder than this.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，看见的是陌生的河。
lines.en: I open my eyes on an unfamiliar river.

lines.zh: 骨头先动，肉才跟上。
lines.en: Bone moves first; flesh follows.

lines.zh: 我从淤泥里抖落一身黑泥。
lines.en: I shake a coat of black mud off me.

lines.zh: 这地方的水草，我没见过。
lines.en: I've never seen weeds like these.

lines.zh: 我的头骨在水面投下影子。
lines.en: My skull casts a shadow on the surface.

lines.zh: 有水，就有我。
lines.en: Where there's water, there I am.

lines.zh: 我摆尾试了试，水很浅。
lines.en: I test a tail-flick; the water is shallow.

lines.zh: 水面响了一下，我抬头看。
lines.en: The water ripples; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我从很久以前游到了这里。
lines.en: I swam here from very long ago.

lines.zh: 河底很安静，我喜欢。
lines.en: The riverbed is quiet. I like it.

lines.zh: 水都烧起来了？我往泥里钻。
lines.en: The water is burning? I dig into the mud.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，骨头差点散了。
lines.en: I fell from a height; my bones nearly came apart.

lines.zh: 我在水里怎么会呛？可我真在呛。
lines.en: How can I drown? Yet I am choking.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，把我从河底掀起来。
lines.en: A blast lifts me off the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我这对鳍像两只船桨。
lines.en: My fins work like two oars.

lines.zh: 紫色的光钻进头骨，冷得发麻。
lines.en: Violet light seeps into my skull, cold and numb.

lines.zh: 鱼都躲起来了，我空了很久。
lines.en: The fish are hiding; I've been empty too long.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，整条河都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the whole river lights up.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There's nothing below, and I keep falling.
